impact.challengesAuthored_other: {{count}} challenges written by this account are kept (only an administrator can edit them)

players.activityNote: Results per day. Data goes up to yesterday.
players.reissueBody: A new code is generated and the old one stops working. The new code is shown only once.
players.newCodeWarning: Write it down now: it will not be shown again. If it is lost, it has to be reissued.
players.deleteWarning: This cannot be undone. The player is deleted along with this data:

groups.help: Drag a player by the handle, or use the "Move to..." button on each card. With a keyboard: focus the handle, press Space, move with the arrow keys and drop with Space. You can tick several players to move them together.
groups.name: Name
groups.empty: There are no groups yet. Create the first one.
groups.codeHint: Share it with the people who need to join this group.
groups.regenerateBody: The current code stops working. Players already in the group are not affected.
groups.deleteWarning: This cannot be undone. Players are not deleted, but they are left without a group. The group is deleted along with this data:

dnd.instructions: To move, press Space. Choose the group with the arrow keys and drop with Space. Escape cancels.

rankings.note: A view for the adults using the panel. Players do not see these lists. Data goes up to yesterday.
rankings.commitmentHelp: Days each player entered and challenges achieved out of those available in the period.
rankings.progressHelp: Current level and score of each player.

dashboard.untilYesterday: Data goes up to yesterday. The current day is not counted yet.
dashboard.untilYesterdayOn: Data goes up to yesterday ({{date}}). The current day is not counted yet.
dashboard.noData: There is no data in this period.
dashboard.showTable: Show table with the same data
dashboard.registrationsSummary: {{total}} registrations in {{days}} days. The peak was {{max}}, on {{date}}.
dashboard.dailySummary: Over {{days}} days: {{entered}} entries and {{withResult}} players with at least one result.
dashboard.durationSummary: Average time in seconds for {{count}} challenges.
dashboard.byDaySummary: Number of results for each challenge on each day of the period.

challenges.pointsHint: Optional. If empty, the points of the difficulty apply.
challenges.assetsHint: Pick from the closed list. Images used in drag objects are added automatically.

mechanicHelp.dragDrop: The player shares objects among containers.
mechanicHelp.numberInput: The player fills numbers into the blanks of an expression.
mechanicHelp.wordDrop: The player drags words into the blanks of a sentence.

challenges.targetCountsHint: Comma-separated numbers, one per container, in order. Example: 3, 5.
challenges.holesHint: Write each blank as {id}, for example: 7 + {a} = 12.
challenges.duplicated: Challenge duplicated. The copy is yours.
challenges.author: Author
challenges.archiveBody: An archived challenge cannot be published in new sets and cannot be unarchived. Sets already published keep it.

err.intMin1: Enter a whole number, 1 or more.
err.intMin0: Enter a whole number, 0 or more.
err.counts: Enter whole numbers separated by commas.
err.countsLength: There must be one number per container.
err.fieldId: Each identifier starts with a lowercase letter and has up to 16 letters or digits.
err.number: Each value must be a number.
err.holes: The {id} blanks in the text must match the identifiers in the list.
err.bankMissing: Each correct word must be in the word bank.

daySets.lockedReason: Read only: a player opened this set on {{when}} and it is now fixed.
daySets.pastReason: Read only: this is a past date.
daySets.noSet: There is no set for this day yet.
daySets.editReverts: Editing it turns it back into a draft and it must be published again.
daySets.rangeWarning: 3 to 5 challenges is recommended ({{min}} to {{max}}) and this set has {{count}}. This is a warning: you can save it anyway.
daySets.deleteWarning: The set is deleted forever and this cannot be undone. Results already saved are kept.
daySets.noGroups: You have no groups assigned yet.
daySets.monthEmpty: There are no sets this month for this group.
daySets.pickDay: Pick a day on the calendar to see or build its set.

rules.readOnly: You can see the rules, but only an administrator can change them.
rules.pointsHint: Points a challenge gives by difficulty, when the challenge does not define its own.
rules.levelsHint: Each block says what is needed to reach the next level. All requirements must be met.
rules.levelsEmpty: There are no level rules yet.
rules.removeLevel: Remove the step from level {{from}} to {{to}}
rules.toleranceHint: 0 to 240. After midnight, a result from the previous day is accepted for this long.
rules.timezoneNote: The time zone is set by the server and cannot be changed from the panel.

err.difficulty: Difficulty is a whole number from 1 to 99.
err.points: Points are a whole number from 0 to 100000.
err.tolerance: Tolerance is a whole number from 0 to 240.
err.minScore: Minimum score is a whole number, 0 or more.
err.requirement: Each requirement needs a difficulty and a minimum, whole numbers of 1 or more.
err.limits: Each limit needs an amount and a window, whole numbers of 1 or more.

rules.limitsHint: Number of requests allowed per IP in each time window.

wordFilter.bad: Write a word of 1 to {{max}} characters.
wordFilter.duplicate: That word is already in the list.
wordFilter.help: Nicknames with these words are not accepted. Every change raises the list version. To change a nickname already registered, open the player's record.

accounts.inviteHint: We email a link to create their account. It expires in 7 days.
accounts.inviteNotSent: The invitation for {{email}} was saved but the email did not go out.
accounts.noInvitationList: The server does not offer a list of pending invitations yet: only the last one sent is shown.
accounts.resetDone: Password reset. All their sessions were closed.
accounts.resetBody: All their sessions are closed and they must change this temporary password when signing in. Give it to them through a secure channel.
accounts.deactivateBody: They cannot sign in and their sessions are closed. It can be activated again.
accounts.activateBody: They will be able to sign in again.
accounts.deleteWarning: The account is deleted forever and this cannot be undone.
